meta.name: ai-image-creator
meta.description: Generate PNG images using AI (multiple models via OpenRouter including Gemini, FLUX.2, Riverflow, SeedDream, GPT-5 Image, proxied through Cloudflare AI Gateway BYOK). Also analyze/describe existing images using multimodal AI vision. Use when user asks to "generate an image", "create a PNG", "make an icon", "make it transparent", "describe this image", "analyze this image", "what's in this image", "explain this image", or needs AI-generated visual assets for the project. Supports model selection via keywords (gemini, riverflow, flux2, seedream, gpt5), configurable aspect ratios/resolutions, transparent backgrounds (-t), reference image editing (-r), image analysis (--analyze), and per-project cost tracking (--costs).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成和编辑图片，支持多种模型与透明背景
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或分析图片，且希望选择不同AI模型
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images with AI, supporting multiple models and transparent backgrounds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate or analyze images with a choice of AI models

howto.what: Claude 能根据描述生成 PNG 图片（支持 Gemini、FLUX.2 等多种模型），也能分析上传的图片并返回文字描述。支持透明背景、参考图片编辑、模型切换和尺寸调整。
howto.when: 当你说“生成一张图片”“描述这张图片”“分析这张图片”等，或需要 AI 创建项目视觉素材时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一个蓝色圆圈的PNG图标，512x512，透明背景。
say.note: Claude 会生成并保存图片文件。

say.text: 用Gemini模型生成一张日落山景图，比例16:9。
say.note: 将使用指定模型和比例生成。

say.text: 分析这张照片：描述颜色、构图和氛围。
say.note: Claude 会分析图片并输出文本。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate PNG images from descriptions (supports models like Gemini, FLUX.2, etc.) and analyze uploaded images returning text descriptions. Supports transparent backgrounds, reference image editing, model switching, and size adjustments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'generate an image', 'describe this image', 'analyze this image', etc., or need AI-created visual assets for a project.

say_en.text: Generate a blue circle PNG icon, 512x512, transparent background.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and save the image file.

say_en.text: Use Gemini model to generate a sunset mountain landscape, 16:9 aspect ratio.
say_en.note: Will use specified model and ratio.

say_en.text: Analyze this photo: describe colors, composition, and mood.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and output text.
